Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human sodium-dependent dopamine transporter (CHEMBL238). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep all activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
